opencode-execution.title: Fixed OpenCode execution
opencode-execution.fixed: The approved tool fixes the model. Changing it requires a newly approved tool configuration.
opencode-execution.allowance: Usage is observed and cost is unpriced. This tool cannot satisfy enforced token or spending limits.
opencode-execution.identity: Configuration acknowledgement does not attest the provider model, bill, independent tests or human acceptance.
opencode-execution.stopped: The private tool service has stopped. Task and test evidence remain separate.
opencode-execution.stop_unknown: The tool service stop has not been confirmed.
opencode-execution.run_progress: Tool progress is an observation. The final execution receipt has not been recorded.
opencode-execution.run_missing: A consistent final execution receipt is unavailable. Review the original run.
opencode-execution.run_mismatch: Execution evidence does not match the fixed configuration or original session. Review the original receipt.
opencode-execution.verification_boundary: After the tool turn completes, review independent tests for the fixed candidate, then have an authorized reviewer accept the task.
opencode-execution.run_failed_unreported: The platform recorded execution failure; no tool-turn receipt was recorded.
opencode-execution.run_tests_scope: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} independent tests in this run.
opencode-execution.run_platform_failed: The tool turn completed, but platform execution failed. Review candidate sealing and test results.
opencode-execution.run_reconciling: The tool returned a result; platform execution still needs reconciliation.
